from headless_terminal import HeadlessTerminal
import time

t = HeadlessTerminal()
out = ""

# 1. basic command
t.send_keystrokes("echo hello world\n", wait_sec=1.0)
out += t.read_output()
print("TEST1 basic:", "hello world" in out)

# 2. bashrc sourced (interactive shell)
out = ""
t.send_keystrokes("echo PS1=${PS1:+set}\n", wait_sec=1.0)
out += t.read_output()
print("TEST2 interactive PS1:", "set" in out)

# 3. modifier key: Ctrl-C
out = ""
t.send_keystrokes("sleep 30\n", wait_sec=0.5)
t.send_keystrokes("\x03", wait_sec=1.0)
out += t.read_output()
print("TEST3 ctrl-c:", "^C" in out or "sleep 30" in out)

# 4. interactive program: python REPL
out = ""
t.send_keystrokes("python3 -c 'import sys; print(sys.stdin.readline().strip().upper())'\n", wait_sec=0.5)
t.send_keystrokes("abc\n", wait_sec=1.0)
out += t.read_output()
print("TEST4 stdin interactive:", "ABC" in out)

# 5. env var set in shell persists
out = ""
t.send_keystrokes("export FOO=bar42\n", wait_sec=0.5)
t.send_keystrokes("echo $FOO\n", wait_sec=1.0)
out += t.read_output()
print("TEST5 export:", "bar42" in out)

t.close()
print("closed, alive:", t.is_alive())
EOF

# Verify sourcing of ~/.bashrc: define a marker function there, check it's available
import os, pathlib
home = pathlib.Path(os.path.expanduser("~"))
bashrc = home / ".bashrc"
marker = "HT_MARKER_TEST=from_bashrc"
orig = bashrc.read_text() if bashrc.exists() else ""
bashrc.write_text(orig + f"\nexport {marker}\n")

from headless_terminal import HeadlessTerminal
t = HeadlessTerminal()
t.send_keystrokes("echo HT=$HT_MARKER_TEST\n", wait_sec=1.0)
out = t.read_output()
t.close()
print("bashrc sourced:", "HT=from_bashrc" in out)

# restore
bashrc.write_text(orig)

# also verify import from a different cwd
import subprocess
r = subprocess.run(["python3", "-c",
    "import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app'); from headless_terminal import HeadlessTerminal; print('import ok')"],
    capture_output=True, text=True, cwd="/tmp")
print(r.stdout.strip(), r.stderr.strip())
EOF
